content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account access today?
I’m having trouble getting into the employee portal. I forgot my password.
No problem. Let’s get you set up. Please go to the main login page and click on ‘Forgot Password’ beneath the password field.
Okay, I see the link. It’s asking for my username or employee number.
Great. Go ahead and enter your employee ID or the username you use for work.
Done. It says it sent a code to my company email.
Perfect. Check your inbox for an email from ‘IT Support’ and enter the verification code here on the portal.
I entered the code. Now it’s asking me to create a new password.
Go ahead and set a new password. Make sure it's at least eight characters and includes both letters and numbers. After that, you should be able to log in as usual.
All set! I’m back into my account now. Thanks for your help.
